title: Deputy Chris Porritt's Myers-era testimony

tellings.quote: deputy sheriff, Chris Porritt, who went on record that long before the Shermans,

plain: A deputy sheriff named Chris Porritt went on record that strange things happened at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of odd lights and creatures, long before the Sherman family lived there, back when Kenneth and Edith Myers owned it. The ranch's current owner, Brandon Fugal, tells Michels this, citing Porritt's account. It matters because it would mean the ranch's strangeness goes back decades, before the reports that made it famous.
